prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign-in hints consistently helped performance, whereas hints outside of sign-in showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Interactive wait screen status updates, wait-stage info, and waiting progress flows were helpful.
Layout modifications and copy updates showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Most new screens and new flows showed no clear effect or hurt performance, except for the hotkey setup screen and specific wait/fallback flows.
Predictions overestimated gains for changes that showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Predictions underestimated gains for unexpected winning changes with low or negative predictions, such as the hotkey setup screen and quick-action redesign.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Saved Pet Auto-Detection Hint: Add a prominent sign-in hint reassuring users that existing desktop pet profiles and customization progress will automatically link to their account. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in again, and sign-in hints have consistently proven effective in past rounds.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Launch Status Interactive Stage Info: Display dynamic diagnostic status messages on the waiting screen showing desktop overlay initialization and asset loading status. (why: 3 support emails reported pets failing to render on the desktop, and interactive wait status screen updates have shown consistent success.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Quick Control Hotkey Guide Screen: Add a new interactive hotkey and quick-control reference screen right after home intro detailing how to show, hide, and summon the pet on desktop. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets, and hotkey setup screens previously proved to be strong winners.)
3: [adoption, wait_info] Custom Pet Generation Fallback Stage Hint: Provide real-time trait processing guidance on the upload photos screen to clarify custom pet generation feedback and prevent creation errors. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures, and adoption is the main funnel bottleneck with only 65.2% step conversion.)
4: [home, new_flow] Desktop Overlay Initialization Wait Flow: Introduce an interactive wait sub-flow during rendering that allows users to test pet trigger responses while assets initialize for desktop launch. (why: The home stage suffers from long wait times (mean 2336s) and missing desktop pets; interactive wait flows consistently improve user retention.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Account Data Continuity Reassurance Hint: Add an explicit reassurance hint to the sign-in screen confirming that user progress, traits, and pet data are safely saved to cloud sync. (why: Directly targets the 8 support emails concerning lost pet data upon sign-in while leveraging proven sign-in hint improvements.)
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop Companion Render Status Wait Tip: Add dynamic tips on the waiting screen explaining system tray options and status updates if the pet does not immediately pop up. (why: 3 support tickets noted pets not appearing on desktop and home mean render time is high (2336s); wait status tips improve user experience during setup.)
